tagline: Leading embedded UI platform provider for automotive, industrial, and IoT applications
hero_kpi_rationale: Qt is a key provider of software platforms for embedded systems in automotive, industrial, and IoT, segments at the heart of digital transformation and AI integration into physical devices. Although indirect, its exposure to HPC and cloud applications through its customers (such as semiconductor manufacturers and equipment suppliers) makes it a structural player in the AI wave.
company_description: Qt Group Oyj offers cross-platform solutions for the software development lifecycle in Finland, rest of Europe, the Asia Pacific, and North America. The company offers Qt Design Studio, which turns design visions into production-ready UIs; Qt Creator IDE, a cross-platform integrated development environment for software development; Qt Framework, a comprehensive set of libraries and APIs; Qt AI Assistant that offloads developers from tasks to free time for coding; Qt for MCUs designs, develops, and tests modern applications for microcontrollers; and Figma to Qt, a plugin that helps to reduce iterations and ensure design comes to life. It also provides quality assurance tools comprising Squish, an automated GUI testing for cross-platform desktop, mobile, embedded, and web applications; Coco for code coverage analysis and tool qualification; Test Center, a test result management platform; Axivion Static Code Analysis, a static code analysis that checks software for style violations; and Axivion Architecture Verification, an automated architecture check that guarantees necessary conformance. kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Net sales increased by 15.7% in 2024, accelerating compared to previous years despite a challenging macroeconomic environment.
kpis.signal: Strong organic growth driven by demand in automotive and industrial sectors.

kpis.name: Operating Result
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating result surged by 33.4% in 2024, exceeding 63 million euros, supported by strong cost control and robust sales growth.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue that translates into operating profit.
kpis.description: Operating margin reached 30.2% in 2024, up 4.3 percentage points year-on-year, significantly exceeding the software sector average.
kpis.signal: Operating margin rising sharply, indicating excellent execution.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Difference between revenue and cost of goods sold.
kpis.description: With a gross margin of 90%, Qt benefits from a highly profitable business model, typical of B2B software vendors.
kpis.signal: Very high gross margin, characteristic of a software model with low variable costs.

kpis.name: R&D Investment (% revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: Qt allocates 25% of its revenue to R&D, a high ratio that supports continuous innovation in embedded interfaces.
kpis.signal: High level of R&D investment, consistent with an innovative software vendor.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending on physical or digital assets to grow the business.
kpis.description: Capital expenditures reached 5.3 million euros in 2024, up 12.8%, primarily directed toward cloud and DevOps platforms.
kpis.signal: Capex rising to strengthen cloud infrastructure and development tools.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of employees in the company.
kpis.description: Headcount stands at 1,200 employees in 2024, down 4% compared to 2023, while revenue is increasing.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in headcount despite growth, indicating productivity gains.

kpis.name: Net Sales
kpis.explanation: Total value of sales generated by the company during the year.
kpis.description: Qt shows a consistent growth trajectory since 2020, with a CAGR of 27%, driven by automotive and Industry 4.0 adoption.
kpis.signal: Sustained five-year growth, fueled by embedded interface adoption.

kpis.name: Operating Result
kpis.explanation: Profit generated from the company's core business operations.
kpis.description: Operating result has more than tripled since 2020, driven by strong revenue growth and operational discipline.

ai_positioning.summary: Qt is gradually integrating AI-related features into its platform, particularly for developer assistance and interface optimization. The company does not position AI as a core product, but as an enabler to enhance its software offering.
evidence: Deployment of AI-assisted development tools in Qt Design Studio
Partnerships with semiconductor vendors integrating AI accelerators
R&D investments focused on embedded use cases with real-time AI processing
